description: This is an HTML file implementing the front-end for a Database Viewer web application. It provides UI components for selecting databases and tables, and dynamically loads and displays table data including support for JSON object preview and content expansion.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML markup for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML markup for an individual cell, supports expansion for long content and JSON objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell's content for better viewing.
